618-1734-3899.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token.
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

618-3899-6966.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of All-Fates Stalker.
When the All-Fates Stalker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the All-Fates Stalker token.
When the All-Fates Stalker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1999-2585-4613-7340.easyPrerequisites: Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
1999-2585-4613-7340.description:
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding at least two mana which you can spend to activate Master Transmuter due to Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Grim Monolith from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sewer-veillance Cam from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Sewer-veillance Cam from the battlefield to your hand, putting Grim Monolith from your hand onto the vattlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam leaves the battlefield, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-5742-5743-7824.description:
Activate Harnfel, Horn of Bounty by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Harnfel, Horn of Bounty ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4552-7280-7824.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Donatello.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

4377-7309-7722.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Don & Leo.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-5078-5901-7656.easyPrerequisites:
There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
Artist's Talent is at least level 2.
3532-5078-5901-7656.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Elena triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

457-1458-4404-6709.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
457-1458-4404-6709.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Ballad of the Black Flag.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

215-3464-3717.description:
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Viridian Joiner.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2067-6235.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
When the Pegasi enter, Agate Instigator triggers that many times, dealing that much damage to each opponent.
2067-6235.notes: This combo can deal twice as much damage if you pay Agate Instigator's offspring cost to control two of them.

1395-3713-5078-6723.description:
Activate Steelfin Whale by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.

483-4681-5170-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-3678-5412.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-3678-5412.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Retreat to Emeria and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1170-1329-1482-6912.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Jeweled Lotus.
Cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Flash Thompson.
When Flash Thompson enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1456-1987-4423-6700.easyPrerequisites:
You have the initiative.
You control three additional Islands.
1456-1987-4423-6700.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Sarevok's Tome by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Sarevok's Tome.
When Mystic Sanctuary and Sarevok's Tome enters untapped, they trigger.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sarevok's Tome trigger, causing you to take the initiative.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Dryad of the Ilysian Grove

277-907-4572-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
277-907-4572-5702.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary. When it enters, Tiller Engine, Selesnya Sanctuary and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad of the Ilysian Grove.
Because of the additional Dryad of the Ilysian Grove token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

2750-3525-6784.description:
Activate Steelswarm Operator's second ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Memnarch by paying {1}{U}{U}, causing Pemmin's Aura to become an artifact.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Steelswarm Operator.
Activate Steelswarm Operator's second ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities of artifacts.
Repeat from step 3.
2750-3525-6784.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Steelswarm Operator's first ability instead.

457-4359-5159-5491.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature with haste named Mishra's Warform, and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Map, adding {U}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it and a Map token for each Mishra's Warform and/or Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-4359-5159-5491.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

372-864-2417.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Eternal Witness exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
372-864-2417.description:
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Eternal Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Eternal Witness trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Siren's Ruse from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Eternal Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

586-2292-3771-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
586-2292-3771-5258-5618.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Driver of the Dead

624-2777-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Phantasmal Image.
When Phantasmal Image dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Driver of the Dead.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

575-2531-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Riptide Pilferer, adding {U}.
When Riptide Pilferer dies, Yedora triggers, returning Riptide Pilferer from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Riptide Pilferer by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Riptide Pilferer's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2034-2267-3119.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
392-2034-2267-3119.description:
Cast Undying Rage by paying {2}{R}, targeting another creature you control.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with Undying Rage attached, adding {C}{C}.
Undying Rage triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

1987-2510-3277-4714.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
1987-2510-3277-4714.description:
Activate Mana Geode by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Mana Geode and Izzet Chronarch, blinking them.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Mana Geode enters the battlefield, scry 1.
Repeat.
